lesson: VLC cannot play DRM-protected content from external streaming platforms.
Changes to Preferences must be explicitly saved, and often require restarting the application to take full effect.
VLC automatically closes when a video ends by default, and there is no setting to keep the window open after playback completes.
VLC does not support DRM-protected content due to licensing restrictions. Content from services like Google Play Movies, Netflix, or other DRM-protected platforms cannot be played in VLC.
VLC has no hardware sensors or ambient light detection. Video adjustments (brightness, contrast) must be configured manually and cannot adapt automatically to environmental conditions.
